name: Check Drug Combination Safety
description: Analyze safety of a drug combination for potential interactions using DDInter database with comprehensive risk assessment and clinical recommendations.
detailed_description: Analyze safety of a drug combination for potential interactions using DDInter database with comprehensive risk assessment and clinical recommendations.
when_to_use: When you need check drug combination safety analysis

parameters.drug_list: [Required] List of drugs to analyze for combination safety (List[str])
parameters.include_mechanisms: [Optional] Include interaction mechanism descriptions in results (default: True)
parameters.include_management: [Optional] Include management recommendations in results (default: True)
parameters.data_lake_path: [Optional] Path to data lake directory containing DDInter data
